papers.title: Evaluations of Co-Cr-Mo meta-biomaterial manufactured by selective laser melting for orthopaedic application
papers.abstract: Meta-biomaterial with rationally design geometrical features provides an exciting opportunity to reduce stress shielding effect and enhance biological fixation as vital criteria for longer durability load-bearing implants. Recently, selective laser melting (SLM), an additive manufacturing has shown significant advantages to produce complex shape which component’s dimensions are close to final dimensions with high degree of interconnected structure. Nonetheless, the available data on achievable accuracy of parts with different geometries from this manufacturing process is scarce. In this study, meta-biomaterials with two different unit cells types made of cobalt chrome molybdenum (Co-Cr-Mo) namely square and diamond are designed with varied unit cell length, Lcell of 1.5 mm and 2.5 mm while strut size, ΦS of 0.4 mm and 0.6 mm then fabricated by SLM. The effects of unit cell geometries on the manufacturability and density were investigated. The manufacturability accuracy has a good geometric agreement between fabricated samples and original computer aid designed models (CAD). The optical microscope images reveal the partially melted metal particles are bonded to the strut surface. The structures with bigger strut size have higher density due to denser struts.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注Co-Cr-Mo多孔材料的制造工艺和密度，未涉及髋关节假体的应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not quantify stress/strain in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact modeling, and lacks patient-specific or intact vs. implanted femur comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造的Co-Cr-Mo多孔材料以减少应力遮挡
summary_zh.method: 设计方孔和菱形单元胞体，改变长度和支柱尺寸，用SLM制造
summary_zh.result: 制造精度高，大支柱密度更高，表面有部分熔化金属颗粒
summary_zh.validation: 光学显微镜观察和密度测量

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the manufacturability of Co-Cr-Mo meta-biomaterials for reducing stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Square and diamond unit cells with varied cell lengths and strut sizes were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: Good geometric agreement between fabricated samples and CAD models was achieved, with larger struts yielding higher density and partially melted particles bonded to strut surfaces.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through optical microscopy and density measurements.

papers.title: New cosurface capacitive stimulators for the development of active osseointegrative implantable devices.
papers.abstract: Non-drug strategies based on biophysical stimulation have been emphasized for the treatment and prevention of musculoskeletal conditions. However, to date, an effective stimulation system for intracorporeal therapies has not been proposed. This is particularly true for active intramedullary implants that aim to optimize osseointegration. The increasing demand for these implants, particularly for hip and knee replacements, has driven the design of innovative stimulation systems that are effective in bone-implant integration. In this paper, a new cosurface-based capacitive system concept is proposed for the design of implantable devices that deliver controllable and personalized electric field stimuli to target tissues. A prototype architecture of this system was constructed for in vitro tests, and its ability to deliver controllable stimuli was numerically analyzed. Successful results were obtained for osteoblastic proliferation and differentiation in the in vitro tests. This work provides, for the first time, a design of a stimulation system that can be embedded in active implantable devices for controllable bone-implant integration and regeneration. The proposed cosurface design holds potential for the implementation of novel and innovative personalized stimulatory therapies based on the delivery of electric fields to bone cells.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或力学测试，仅关注电刺激对骨整合的影响。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发无药物的电刺激方法促进骨植入体整合。
summary_zh.method: 设计共面电容系统，数值分析结合体外细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 体外实验中成骨细胞增殖和分化成功。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞培养验证刺激效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a non-pharmacological biophysical stimulation method for enhancing bone-implant integration in active intramedullary implants.
summary_en.method: Proposed a cosurface capacitive stimulator design with numerical analysis and in vitro cell culture experiments.
summary_en.result: The system successfully promoted osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell tests with osteoblasts validated the efficacy of the electrical stimulation system.
